author: nickzulu3
body:
Hello Avicus Staff Team,

My name is nickzulu3, you probably know me as I used to be a staff member.

Anyways today I am here to report Zac your TeamSpeak Developer for abusing his powers and false banning me.

So as you know on TeamSpeak there is a rule that your username has to be similar or the same as you IGN. Me and some people were talking one day and I changed my TS name to ComeAtMeZac. He then proceeded to ask me to change my username to my IGN so I did, I changed it to ComeAtMeZac (nickzulu3). That name should have been totally fine according to the TeamSpeak rules but then Zac proceeded to tell me to change it or else he'd kick me. I knew I was doing nothing wrong here so I told him, "I'm not going to change it, I am doing nothing against the rules and if you want to kick me, go ahead". And of course he kicked me. So I re-logged onto the server. When I entered he told me I have 10 seconds to change it or else I get banned and again, I was doing nothing wrong so he banned me for 2 hours for, "Harassing user with TS name". As a disclaimer I asked multiple staff members before I got banned if I was doing anything wrong and they told me I was not and that if he banned me it would be bs. Then we come to today, I log into Avicus TeamSpeak and Zac tells me 20 seconds to change my username or I get banned, and again I told him, "No I am not doing anything wrong" and of course he then banned me for 24 hours which is currently active at the time of me posting this.

I would very much appreciate it if this gets taken care of as it seems unfair.

Gyazo of me being kicked: https://gyazo.com/b905d20628b958ed865dd1f51a3fb140

I didn't get a gyazo of me being banned the first time but VenomousViper whitnessed it.

Gyazo of me being banned the second time:
https://gyazo.com/d0965928618e35ac76737b2cb46d13bc

Thank you for your time reading this and I hope it gets taken care of,

Yours truly, -nickzulu3

replies.body:
Heeya nick,

Thanks for the report.
The player is no longer a TS dev and has been network banned.
Keep the work up and I'll also remind the seniors about your appeal.

Regards Flo/resepignev.
